From the brand

  2. Comfort Without Compromise

    Why do quality shoes cost so much and affordable ones feel so mediocre? At Project Cloud, we deliver the best of both worlds by crafting shoes for women, men, and kids that blend premium comfort and materials with timeless style. Our direct-to-consumer model cuts costs, not quality, so every step feels effortless for busy moms, active dads, and playful kids. Walk on clouds with footwear that delivers value & durability.

  3. How did we get our start?

    Project Cloud began with a question: why do affordable shoes always lack premium quality? We’re on a mission to redefine comfort, crafting shoes for families that feel and look great.

    What makes our products unique?

    Our shoes elevate classics with modern comfort technology and premium materials. A limited selection gives us focus, ensuring comfort and value.

    Why do we love what we do?

    We love making life easier, one step at a time. Our shoes support women, men, and kids in every moment, from errands to playtime, with comfort and quality families can trust and afford.

Product description

Eco-crafted leather. Naturally Soft and Breathable

Created from eco-crafted leather, each pair delivers a soft, supple feel that only gets better with time. Our eco-crafted leather is carefully selected for texture, durability, and color depth — giving you that rich, refined look that holds up season after season.

Ready for Real Life. Water-Resistant Protection Built In

A protective finish helps repel light rain, splashes, and stains — keeping your sneakers looking new, longer. It’s the kind of everyday protection that lets you move confidently from morning errands to evening plans, no matter the forecast.

Non-Slip Sole

Meet your new go-to for stability—our non-slip sole! Designed to keep you steady on your feet, it’s built for every step, every surface, and every adventure. No more slipping, sliding, or second-guessing your footing—just solid, reliable grip wherever you go.

Rainy sidewalks? Slick floors? No problem. Walk with confidence, knowing your every step is secure and supported.

Durable Strong Stitching

These sneakers are not just about fashion; they're about lasting power. We understand the importance of footwear that stands up to the test of time, that's why our Little Irita come equipped with durable strong stitching.

No more worrying about wear and tear. Our expertly crafted stitching ensures that your sneakers stay together through all your adventures. From city strolls to nights out, these are designed to move comfortably with you.

Lightweight & Flexible Comfort

Tired of sore, achy feet? Step into all-day comfort with these sneakers for kids. Designed for flexibility, durability, and lightweight wear, they feature a genuine Eco-friendly leather insole with memory foam cushioning that delivers plush, breathable support with every step. The water-resistant design helps keep them stain-proof, while the durable outsole provides reliable grip and stability. Perfect for everyday wear, these women’s sneakers combine comfort, support, and long-lasting quality.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Bought these Project Cloud kids tennis shoes for my daughter because she’s constantly on the move—think less “child” and more “tiny tornado in glitter.” I wanted something that could keep up with her, and these shoes absolutely deliver.

    The quality is impressive. Solid stitching, durable materials, and they’ve survived recess, a spilled juice box, and a surprise game of backyard mud tag. So far, not a single tear or complaint (from the shoes OR the kid).

    As for comfort, my daughter says they feel "like jumping on marshmallows," which I take as a glowing endorsement. She wears them without whining—which is the gold standard of children’s footwear reviews in my house.

    Value-wise, they’re a total win. They look and feel like they should cost a lot more than they do, which is great because kids outgrow things faster than I can say “I just bought those!”

    BUT—and this is important—they run small. I had to return the first pair and size up, which was only mildly frustrating because my daughter had already emotionally bonded with them. Cue the tiny dramatic meltdown. Once we got the right size, though? Smooth sailing.

    TL;DR: Buy them. Just go a size up, and prepare to hear the words “these are my favorite shoes EVER” roughly once a day.
